correction: User removed STORY-02-008 (Bronze integration-test, verification-only) from STORY-03-001 Depends On. Rationale: integration-test stories verify runtime behavior of a layer but are not code prerequisites for downstream-layer code-authoring stories — those depend on the upstream BUILD stories that produce the artifacts (e.g., STORY-01-003 for scd2 helper).
pattern: When wiring cross-epic Depends On for a code-authoring (build) story in layer N, never list integration-test or deploy-validation stories from layer N-1 as dependencies. Code-authoring stories depend only on the upstream BUILD/foundation stories whose deliverables they import or extend. Closure stories (perf, integration-test, deploy-validation) are intra-layer gates and must not appear as cross-epic prerequisites for downstream build work.

correction: STORY-02-006 lacked an explicit deliverable AC for src/patient_360/bronze/reconciliation.py, so the LLD §13 Decision 12 revision (UC removed from runtime, build_spark lost uc_uri kwarg) did not flow through the chain — update-dag does not touch python modules and update-ingestion only touches files declared in story ACs. The file failed at runtime with TypeError: build_spark() got an unexpected keyword argument uc_uri until a direct-edit fix on 2026-05-22. Captured in LLD-DEVIATIONS row 8.
pattern: When a layer-orchestration story (e.g. a DAG story) declares helper python modules under src/<project>/<layer>/ as part of its deliverables (reconciliation, bootstrap, custom operators), explicitly list each helper file path in a dedicated AC with file_exists + forbidden_grep guards for retired contracts (e.g. uc_uri, UCSingleCatalog when UC is removed from runtime). Never rely on the AC narrative alone — the update-* skills only touch files whose paths appear verbatim in an AC.
